query:
WITH selection AS (SELECT ? AS subject), selected AS (
 SELECT json_extract(subject, '$.kind') AS kind, json_extract(subject, '$.subject') AS id,
 CASE json_extract(subject, '$.kind') WHEN 'workstream' THEN json_extract(subject, '$.subject') WHEN 'task' THEN (SELECT workstream_id FROM tasks WHERE task_id = json_extract(subject, '$.subject')) END AS workstream FROM selection)
SELECT r.id AS "id!: String" FROM record_identities r CROSS JOIN selected
JOIN notify_intents i ON i.intent_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN record_identities cause ON cause.kind = i.cause_kind AND cause.id = i.cause_id
LEFT JOIN record_identities thread ON thread.kind = 'thread' AND i.cause_kind = 'post' AND thread.id = CASE json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.placement.kind') WHEN 'thread' THEN json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.placement.threadId') ELSE i.cause_id END
LEFT JOIN record_identities about_trail INDEXED BY sqlite_autoindex_record_identities_1 ON about_trail.kind = 'workTrailRow' AND json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.kind') = 'workTrailRow' AND about_trail.id = CAST(json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.subject') AS TEXT)
WHERE r.kind = 'notifyIntent' AND r.id > ? AND (
 selected.kind = 'project' OR i.cause_kind = selected.kind AND i.cause_id = selected.id
 OR (json_extract(CASE json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.kind') WHEN 'resolved' THEN json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.recipient.viaRole.subject') ELSE json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.recipient.subject') END, '$.kind') = 'workstream' AND json_extract(CASE json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.kind') WHEN 'resolved' THEN json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.recipient.viaRole.subject') ELSE json_extract(r.payload, '$.record.recipient.recipient.subject') END, '$.subject') = selected.workstream)
 OR i.cause_kind = 'roleAssignment' AND (json_extract(json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject'), '$.kind') = 'workstream' AND json_extract(json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject'), '$.subject') = selected.workstream)
 OR i.cause_kind = 'workTrailRow' AND (json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject.kind') = selected.kind AND json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject.subject') = selected.id OR selected.kind = 'workstream' AND json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject.kind') = 'task' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks matching_task WHERE matching_task.task_id = json_extract(cause.payload, '$.record.subject.subject') AND matching_task.workstream_id = selected.id))
 OR i.cause_kind = 'post' AND ((json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.kind') = selected.kind AND json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.subject') = selected.id OR selected.kind = 'workstream' AND json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.kind') = 'task' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks matching_task WHERE matching_task.task_id = json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.subject') AND matching_task.workstream_id = selected.id))
 OR json_extract(thread.payload, '$.record.about.kind') = 'workTrailRow' AND (json_extract(about_trail.payload, '$.record.subject.kind') = selected.kind AND json_extract(about_trail.payload, '$.record.subject.subject') = selected.id OR selected.kind = 'workstream' AND json_extract(about_trail.payload, '$.record.subject.kind') = 'task' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks matching_task WHERE matching_task.task_id = json_extract(about_trail.payload, '$.record.subject.subject') AND matching_task.workstream_id = selected.id))))
ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 101
